q: By December 31, 2026, Germany's Bundestag passes a 2027 federal budget that allocates more than the €11.6 billion in the government's draft for military support to Ukraine (resolves no if the budget is not passed by year-end)
basis: On July 6, the German cabinet approved a 2027 budget draft with €11.6 billion for military support to Ukraine, and the Bundestag is scheduled to hold its final vote in November. For the 2026 budget, the Bundestag added about €3 billion in Ukraine support during its deliberations. In 2027, however, sharply higher defense spending and heavy new borrowing leave little room for an increase. With U.S. aid reduced, the outcome will show whether Europe's largest donor to Ukraine increases its support further.
rs: Records of the adopted budget from Germany's Federal Ministry of Finance and the Bundestag (the comparison uses total military support to Ukraine counted on the same basis as the €11.6 billion in the government's draft)
